'''Volume 1''' is the first volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of [[Shogakukan]]'s collected releases of the magazine version.

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{Steven}} studies strange murals found in [[Granite Cave]] alongside [[Ultima]].
* Fearing another disaster will strike Hoenn, Steven decides to have {{adv|Ruby}}, {{adv|Sapphire}}, and {{adv|Emerald}} learn [[Mega Evolution]].
* It is revealed that {{adv|Ruby}} has a [[Mega Bracelet]] and Latios and Latias have their respective [[Mega Stone]]s.
* Steven contacts [[Mr. Stone|his father]] and sends him the strange murals found in Granite Cave.
* Ruby and {{p|Latios}} travel to the [[Sky Pillar]] after using Mega Evolution for the first time.
* It is revealed that Steven has the Mega Stones for the respective [[Hoenn first partner Pokémon]] [[Evolution]]s.
* Ruby meets [[Zinnia]] and battles her.
* Ruby manages to beat Zinnia and asks for her help to stop the crisis about to hit Hoenn.
* An asteroid is expected to hit Hoenn in 10 days.
* Both {{adv|Sapphire}} and {{adv|Emerald}} master Mega Evolution.

==Party changes==
===Additions===

===Evolutions===
* Ruby's [[Rara]] evolves into {{p|Gardevoir}} ([[PS596]])
* Sapphire's Kirly evolves into a {{p|Gallade}} ([[PS596]])
